decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm’s pipeline and valve offering, it fits existing customers and production well, so its option value remains high while its carrying cost is low.

Although more distant from the core range, the waste bin can still use the firm’s metalworking and coating capabilities and municipal customer access, so a low-cost wait-and-see approach is still plausible.
This variant is distant from the core business but offers a clearer municipal application than a plain bin and can be kept as a relatively inexpensive diversification option.

A standalone public ashtray is the narrowest and least strategic of the distant products, and with several other options in the portfolio management is likelier to reallocate attention to stronger core or adjacent lines.
